author: piratewithgun
body:
I'm sure that most of you know that before the Omega update there was a command that would show you your current kills and deaths, aswell as a KD ratio: /match or /m. It has been removed, and although it wasn't a massive feature, it is something that I miss, and I know that a lot of other players miss using this command! 

Was it removed for a particular valid reason? And if not is there any chance of having it back again?

Thanks :)

replies.author: GrantInPhoenix
replies.body:
+1

also maybe /mstats (match stats so you'd know what your ongoing stats are during a live match)
and maybe allow the feature of letting players /stats other players tho it has its pros and cons

Pros
- you can make sure someone isn't lying about their stats or leaderboard rank
- you can keep up and use it as motivation to aim for higher/better stats

Cons
- you could end up getting targeted cuz of your stats and ppl might envy
- you'd be tempted to target that player and boast about killing them
